meta.description: Rahu Kalam - inauspicious period ruled by Rahu, varies by weekday

calculation.note: Day divided into 8 equal parts from sunrise to sunset. Rahu Kalam is one part, position varies by weekday.
calculation.sequence_mnemonic: Mother Saw Father Wearing The Turban Suddenly (Mon=1, Sat=1, Fri=6, Wed=4, Thu=5, Tue=3, Sun=7)

translations.en: Rahu Kalam is universally inauspicious — no auspicious activity should commence during this period.
translations.hi: राहु काल सार्वभौमिक रूप से अशुभ है — इस अवधि में कोई शुभ कार्य आरंभ नहीं करना चाहिए।
